claims.claim_text: 把 prefill-heavy 工作負載做到最高 4.7 倍加速、decode-heavy 3.1 倍
claims.evidence: improve inference performance by approximately 3.1x for Decode-heavy and by approximately 4.7x for Prefill-heavy workloads (512 Concurrency tier).

claims.claim_text: 放棄傳統 8-way tensor parallelism，改用注意力層資料平行加上 MoE 層 expert parallelism，解掉原本把並行度卡在約 200 requests 的記憶體冗餘
claims.evidence: 8-way Attention Batch Sharding (DP=8) combined with 8-way Expert Parallelism (EP=8); TP=8 forces fractional head sharding, physically impossible; limiting the system to roughly ~200 concurrent requests instead of the planned 512.

claims.claim_text: 作者實測有 16.6% 的分支誤預測 ... Rust 實作從 45,981 微秒降到 7,106 微秒，快了 6.5 倍
claims.evidence: Classic 16.6% branch misprediction; 45,981.1 µs -> 7,106.3 µs (ratio ~6.47x, rounds to 6.5x); branchless 0.0% mispredictions.

claims.claim_text: 作者一句話總結：「分支誤預測完全消失了。」
claims.evidence: Branch mispredictions are completely gone. (branchless table shows 0.0%).

claims.claim_text: 兩者中位數只差 0.14 ms（4.79 對 4.93 ms）... 真正該避開的是多付 3.13 ms 的 XWayland；VRR 則是降延遲最有感的開關
claims.evidence: X11 4.79 ms vs Wayland 4.93 ms; XWayland adds 3.13 ms of latency; VRR has the biggest impact across the pairings.

claims.claim_text: 這則新聞同時出現在 Hacker News 與 Lobsters。
claims.evidence: The item's own source (the author's blog) says nothing about aggregator presence; the cross-source-cluster fact (HN+Lobsters) is curation metadata, not an article claim. Sentence deleted from the lede.

claims.claim_text: 系統其實得在平行啟動、優先新的、等待、優先舊的這四種語意之間做選擇 ... 沒有上限的佇列可以悄悄堆到十萬筆 ... 這些語意用基本原語湊不出來
claims.evidence: Parallel Spawn / Prefer New / Wait / Prefer Old; queue position as 100K+; If the Prefer Old semantics are not offered, you can't really emulate them using the two primitives.
